clues.text: A royal visitor from this land arrived in Jerusalem with a very large caravan of camels.
In Job's complaint, the travelers of this land hoped to find water in streams that had dried up.
Jokshan, a son born to Abraham by Keturah, was the father of this one and Dedan.
A royal psalm prays that gold from this land would be given to the king.
Isaiah foresaw all from this land coming, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.
Through Jeremiah, God asked what use frankincense from this land was when Judah's sacrifices did not please Him.
In Ezekiel's lament over Tyre, merchants from this land traded gold, the finest spices, and precious stones there.
